note: Textimage renders text onto images by pairing Image Effects' 'Text overlay' effect with text from field values, the textimage.factory API, tokens, or direct URL generation. It ships two field formatters (textimage_text_field_formatter for text/text_long/text_with_summary, textimage_image_field_formatter for image), a settings config object textimage.settings (default_extension, url_generation.enabled/text_separator, default_font, debug), image-style third-party option (uri_scheme), tokens [entity:textimage-url:field]/[entity:textimage-uri:field], and one permission 'generate textimage url derivatives'. Medium/hard cases are grounded in real config that does NOT require GD/font rendering: introspection reads textimage.settings values; execution switches a field's view-display formatter to textimage_text_field_formatter and flips url_generation on, verified against live config.

evals.prompt: How does the Drupal Textimage module actually put text onto an image? Which image effect / module does it build on, and where does the text come from?
evals.expected_output: Textimage relies on the Image Effects module's 'Text overlay' image effect inside an image style: the effect's Default text is replaced at render time by text coming from a field value, the textimage.factory API, or a URL path.

evals.prompt: Which field formatters does the Textimage module provide, and what are their machine IDs and applicable field types?
evals.expected_output: Two formatters: textimage_text_field_formatter (for text, text_long, text_with_summary fields) and textimage_image_field_formatter (for image fields). Each takes an image_style setting pointing to a style with a Text overlay effect.

evals.prompt: In Drupal Textimage, which tokens return the location (URL or URI) of a generated Textimage image for a field?
evals.expected_output: [<entity>:textimage-url:<field>{:display}{:sequence}] for the URL and [<entity>:textimage-uri:<field>{:display}{:sequence}] for the URI, e.g. [node:textimage-url:field_tagline].

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, what image file format (extension) will Textimage generate by default for its derivatives? Inspect the live Textimage configuration.
evals.expected_output: jpg — textimage.settings has default_extension: jpg (read via `drush cget textimage.settings default_extension`).

evals.prompt: Is Textimage's direct URL-based image generation enabled on this site, and if so what is the configured text separator used to split URL text into separate Text overlay effects? Inspect the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: URL generation is enabled and the text_separator is '###' — textimage.settings url_generation.enabled: true, url_generation.text_separator: '###'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has a text field field_ti_head. Configure the default view display so this field is rendered with Textimage's text field formatter (textimage_text_field_formatter). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_ti_head component has type: textimage_text_field_formatter (e.g. set the component via the entity_display.repository view display and save, or pick 'Textimage' on Manage display).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, enable Textimage's direct URL-based image generation so images can be produced straight from a URL path. Apply the change to the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: textimage.settings url_generation.enabled is set to TRUE (e.g. via configFactory getEditable('textimage.settings')->set('url_generation.enabled', TRUE)->save(), or tick 'Enable' on /admin/config/media/textimage).
